verdict.rationale: stagewise runs your dev server inside its IDE, and its agent can interact with live browser tabs via CDP. The GitHub README says the agent has full access to the tab's console and debugger, and the docs say it takes screenshots to debug visually, so the agent debugs the running app directly. A community user confirms the prefabbed ability to have the agent look at the live UI. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the debugger capabilities (breakpoints, network and state inspection), independent hands-on corroboration of console/debugger-driven bug fixing, and documented support for debugging backend processes alongside the frontend.
